name: Frames Group
description: Turnkey process and separation systems integrator, historically oil and gas. Its product families still include produced water treatment, electrostatic coalescers and oil/water multiphase separation, though the company now positions itself toward hydrogen; a Plug Power subsidiary since December 2021.
products: Gas and liquid sweetening / sulphur recovery
